fact_text: Maple Leaf Cement reported Q1 FY26 EPS of PKR 2.60, reported as up 2 times year on year but down about 25% quarter on quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Maple Leaf Cement's Q1 FY26 net sales were PKR 16.48 billion, down 5% quarter on quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Maple Leaf Cement's Q1 FY26 gross margin was 34%, up 2.4 percentage points year on year but below the 38% gross margin of the Q4 FY25 quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Maple Leaf Cement's other income was PKR 59 million in Q1 FY26, up 91% year on year but down 68% quarter on quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The margin fall was attributed to lower retention prices, lower export and local dispatches, and one-off costs booked by management for production lines that were shut down during the quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Provisional cement industry figures for the quarter ended December 2025 showed dispatches up 5% quarter on quarter, with local dispatches higher, exports lower and prices rebounding.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Maple Leaf Cement announced an acquisition of Pioneer Cement, as reported in the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst assumed Maple Leaf would borrow about PKR 70 billion for Pioneer, while Pioneer's full-year profit is about PKR 5 billion, so higher finance charges would weigh on earnings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst expected Maple Leaf's earnings to stay broadly flat in FY27 against FY26, because higher finance charges from the acquisition debt would offset growth in cement dispatches.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Adding other comprehensive income lifts Maple Leaf's Q1 FY26 earnings to about PKR 3.70 per share, while annual depreciation with an impact of about PKR 4 per share would cut earnings to about PKR 1.5.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Maple Leaf Cement's capacity utilisation was 26% in FY25.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst expected Maple Leaf's utilisation to stay under 40% in FY26, and said even about 50% utilisation in FY27 would still leave earnings around PKR 10-11 per share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst said the stock looked fairly valued at its price on the publication date, given expected FY26 and FY27 earnings of about PKR 10-11 per share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: International Steels' Q1 FY26 net revenue was PKR 20.9 billion, up 26% quarter on quarter, with gross margin of 11.2%, up 4.5 percentage points year on year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: International Steels' distribution expenses rose 52% to PKR 82 million in Q1 FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: After the budget, anti-dumping duties on steel were repositioned, reducing dumping from China and the Fata region and lifting volumes for local cold-rolled coil (CRC) producers, the reporter said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The budget reduced the duty on steel raw materials, notably hot-rolled coil (HRC), to below 2.5%, a change the reporter said is visible in the Q1 FY26 margins of steel makers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: International Steels' utilisation was only about 25% in FY25, so higher volumes were expected to lift utilisation and margins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: International Steels' latest-quarter margin was about 11.7%, which the analyst viewed as sustainable at the reported volume levels, with volumes possibly growing further.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The competition regulator fined International Steels and another CRC producer for cartel conduct, with the fine about 1% of annual sales; ISL is contesting the fine in the Supreme Court.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: If ISL loses the Supreme Court case, the fine would have to be booked, which the analyst estimated would cut EPS by about PKR 1 to 1.5 per share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: On an unconsolidated basis, Fauji Foods' Q3 FY26 net sales fell 13% quarter on quarter to about PKR 6 billion, and gross margin fell 2.1 percentage points to 17%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Fauji Foods' other income rose 20% to PKR 15 million in Q3 FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst attributed the Q3 FY26 sales and margin decline to the July and August floods, which hurt volumes and disrupted the supply chain.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Fauji Foods' margin fell from about 19% to under 18% over the stated quarters, as reported in the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Fauji Foods' UHT milk segment holds only about 10% of the milk market, with loose milk making up most of the rest of the market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Fauji Foods was loss-making until 2023 and turned profitable in 2024 and 2025, as stated in the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst said Fauji Foods' move toward business-to-business sales lifted utilisation, and in-house, localised packaging in place of imported packaging is improving margins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The price gap between open loose milk and packaged milk is about PKR 100, as stated in the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst observed consumers moving back toward loose milk despite health concerns, and said a tax exemption or GST cut for the dairy sector in the budget would lift packaged milk volumes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: Management targets about PKR 100 billion in sales by 2029, which would need roughly 30% sales growth over four to five years; the analyst assumed operating margin rising from under 10% to about 12-13%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst's model put Fauji Foods' earnings at about PKR 2.5 to 3 per share by 2029 if management's sales and margin expectations are met.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)

fact_text: The analyst said Fauji Foods' operating margin is under 10%, against roughly 17-18% at Nestle and Engro Foods, because those peers hold higher market share, so gaining share could improve profitability.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Results Review: MLCF ISL FFL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-31)
